Use case: ui-mockup. HIGH-FIDELITY UI REDESIGN for CouncilKit, a Chinese local-first multi-agent PR review tool. Single desktop web application screen at 1440x1024, not a poster or mobile mock, no browser chrome or device. This is V2 of an existing dark design. Use the attached v1 image only as the product/brand reference, but substantially refine the hierarchy and avoid its giant red headline, giant green checkmarks, repetitive cards, redundant tabs, and gold gradient buttons.
Art direction: quiet editorial technical workspace, beautifully typeset reports, fine alignment, intentionally empty breathing room, readable body. All surfaces completely FLAT solid colors (no radial gradients, glow, noise, 3D, shadows or gold metallic shine). Page #0b0d10, nav #15181d, subtle raised #1e2128, borders #232830. Primary text #e6e8ec, muted #a0a6b0, warm heading #efe4cf, brass #c4a574 only for active selection and a single modest primary action. Use red #f85149 as small severity labels only; green #22c55e as tiny execution-complete status dot; blue #58a6ff for current live activity. Never use big colorful circles or make numbers red just because they are counts.
Fonts: crisp Chinese system sans, 15-16px body with 25px line height; secondary min13px; page title28px, section20px. Monospace only SHA/path/time/code. No decorative extra fonts. Restrained 6px radius; button/input40px. Refined divider/list rhythm, minimal borders, not everything in cards.
GLOBAL invariant:208px full-height left sidebar. Small regular CouncilKit wordmark top x24 y32 (match original brand rather than invent large italic logo). Nav 首页, 新建讨论, 产品创意, 报告 selected with subtle surface tint + thin brass left rule, no gold wide-filled navigation tile. Bottom 设置 then tiny green dot Host 在线. Main content x248 to1400. Top compact breadcrumb "报告 / piston #413". Current date anchor2026-09-20. All data DEMO; small text "演示数据" in metadata. No real sensitive data.
Design truth rules: execution success NEVER equals approved; single-seat output is independent. Use exact copy supplied. Do not invent findings, validation/approval badges, retry buttons, evidence linkage, mock progress % or ETA. No developer-facing protocol prose in user content. Preserve existing report/process functionality and use accurate short Chinese text. Frontend handoff image must have no contradictory status or truncated main control.
SCREEN: V2 审查总览, delivery A, finished aggregate report with existing RUN-level findings. This image is NOT a single-seat structured-verdict concept.
Layout: main header at y36 breadcrumb; y76 "piston #413" 28px, top right quiet text "打开 PR ↗" and outlined button "复制报告". Under title one compact metadata line "本轮审查 · SHA 6424bc1 · 22m09s · 演示数据". Use no all-caps English headers.
At y160 use a small red outlined pill "需要修改" followed by muted tiny green dot "审查执行完成". At y202 an editorial statement in 23px warm white "重连恢复仍有三项优先问题". Below 2 short lines "汇总发现 7 项问题。先处理正文重复、无退避重连与空文本完成帧，再验证新版本。". This is demo report summary. Under summary tiny neutral counts "1 致命   2 重大   3 次要   1 建议", only severity words lightly tinted, digits neutral. NO BIG RED HERO WORDS. Thin separator at y306.
Main 2-column content below: left 760px, right~280px separated by whitespace and ONE subtle vertical line. Left heading "审查发现" with small plain controls 全部7 / 优先3 selected. No top page tab for 席位结果. Right rail has sole seat result entry, do not duplicate elsewhere.
Left finding list three strong editorial rows each ~145px:
red small text 致命, warm title "重放可能重复拼接已完成正文", secondary monospace "sessionEventTimeline.ts:269", paragraph "历史片段在重连后再次追加，可能导致正文重复。", footer neutral "来源：对抗审查" no 独立验证 badge, trailing subtle chevron.
amber 重大, title "自动重连缺少退避", path "index.tsx:921", paragraph "连接结束后反复全量拉取，增加持续请求与重复回放。", footer "来源：安全审查、对抗审查".
amber 重大, title "空文本完成帧可能清空正文", path "sessionEventTimeline.ts:49", paragraph "空文本完成事件被错误处理，重连后已接收内容可能丢失。", footer "来源：正确性审查".
Then text "展开其余 4 项" and thin separator with heading "汇总报告" and 2 short preview lines of prose at bottom, "展开完整报告" link.
Right rail heading "席位报告" small metadata "5/5 已交付". Exactly five compact72px rows with role 安全审查/正确性审查/可维护性审查/对抗审查/兼容性审查 and small green dot + exact "执行完成", trailing "阅读 →". NO per-seat finding counts, NO model names primary, NO circular large checks. Below a tiny Aggregator done row "汇总报告已生成".
Lower right a sober next action separated by rule: label "下一步", one brass flat button "开始修复" at y835, small explanatory two-line copy "会修改代码并推送，随后复审。" Do not duplicate gold actions throughout.
The design should look materially more mature and quiet than v1: warm text dominates, red only tags, no giant status billboard or boxed seat panel.

Main breadcrumb "报告 / piston #413 / 席位报告". Header y80 left "对抗审查" with discreet dropdown chevron for switching role. Right buttons quiet "返回总览" and brass flat "复制报告". Under title one line tiny green dot "执行完成" then metadata "grok-4.6 · 15m47s". Next secondary mono metadata line "Run ck-review-demo · SHA 6424bc1 · 当前执行 e3 · 演示数据". At y190 a neutral single-line information strip on slightly raised dark, no yellow/red, regular small info icon, exact text "报告已生成，暂无结构化摘要。以下为席位原文。" This should be quiet, normal, not alert-like.
Content x248-1080 readable report document with right sticky narrow outline x1150-1400 separated only whitespace/one vertical divider. Right outline title "报告目录", four links 审查范围(selected), 观察与分析, 建议验证, 历史过程. A small source footer "席位独立报告" and "结论以原文为准". No fabricated semantic sections if not present — demo original contains these exact headings.
Document y260: title "重连与消息重放审查" 24px warm white. Small title-adjacent label "席位原文". Body realistic exact text in comfortably spaced Chinese:
Heading "审查范围"
"本次检查覆盖事件重放、断线恢复与消息合并，重点关注重连前后的内容一致性。"
Heading "观察与分析"
"在连接恢复后，历史片段会重新进入消息合并逻辑。已完成正文是否再次追加，需要结合事件序号与当前消息状态判断。"
"现有测试覆盖了顺序到达的事件，但混合历史重放与空文本完成帧仍值得补充验证。"
Inset compact monospace code block with flat dark surface, copy icon subtle, exact two lines:
"首次接收 → 完成消息"
"断线重连 → 重放历史 → 检查正文一致性"
Heading "建议验证"
Three numbered prose lines "1. 重放相同历史，确认正文不会重复。", "2. 接收空文本完成帧后重连，确认内容仍保留。", "3. 模拟连续断线，观察重连请求是否收敛。".
Bottom y900 FULL WIDTH QUIET disclosure "历史过程" with metadata "57 次工具调用 · 15m33s 记录跨度" and small chevron "展开". No timeline above or mixed inside report.
Typography and spacing should make original report a first-class deliverable, no sad illustration, no empty placeholders, no '解析失败' red badge, no '0项问题', no invented recommendation verdict. Allow modest whitespace and fit complete content naturally.

prompts.refinementPrompt: Edit this CouncilKit V2 failure screen. Preserve the entire design, all text, layout, colors, sizes, and content except one precise cleanup: in the TOP RIGHT HEADER, remove the redundant "复制诊断" button (document icon button), and right-align the remaining "返回总览" button at its place. Keep the lower inline "复制诊断信息" beside the gold "查看已保存过程" action unchanged, so there is exactly ONE copy-diagnostics action on the screen. Do not remove any failure explanation, history or context. Keep target dimensions/aspect and everything else identical. This is a targeted UI redundancy correction, not a redesign.
